<div class="card-body">
'''Death Star: Level 4 Military Corridor''' is a [[Dark]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">デス・スター：レベル４軍用通路</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを支配したなら、フォース消耗を＋１できる。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">自分の移動フェイズで、帝国軍はここから任意のデス・スターの位置へ移動コスト無しで移動できる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-286o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Death Star: Level 4 Military Corridor.

'''Light Side:''' If you control here, you may add 1 to the Force drain.

'''Dark Side:''' During your move phase, Imperials may move from here to any Death Star location at no movement cost.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese Dark moves to any Death Star location at no movement cost; English moves free to any one Death Star site.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Death Star: Level 4 Military Corridor]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
